name: Yahoo Inc
description: DELISTED - Yahoo! Inc. (Yahoo!) is a digital media company. Through the Company's technology and insights, Yahoo! delivers digital content and experiences, across devices and globally. The Company provides online properties and services (Yahoo! Properties) to users, as well as a range of marketing services designed to reach and connect with those users on Yahoo! and through a distribution network of third-party entities (Affiliates). These Affiliates integrate its advertising offerings into their Websites or other offerings (those Websites and other offerings, Affiliate sites). Its offerings to users on Yahoo! Properties fall into three categories: Communications and Communities, Search and Marketplaces, and Media. In October 2013, Yahoo! Inc acquired Hitpost Inc. In October 2013, Yahoo! Inc acquired Bread Labs Inc.
